about: Manual photo review: every photo a place shows must be food, drinks or the interior, never people (chef, staff, guests, portraits, hands). Applied by scripts/apply_photo_review.py <city> (see its docstring). posts: Instagram post shortcode → category (people / graphic are never shown). heroReject: own-site og:images with people. hold: places where only photos with people were found → neutral placeholder, nothing shown. dropPhotos: {id: {src substring: why}} own / free-licence photos with people, removed from the place record. cropResearch: {id/file-stem: [l,t,r,b] fractions} crop for a website research photo (self-hosted). skipResearch: research candidates not to use. Reviewed 26 Oct 2026 (contact sheets + face detection; research hand-off /workspace/handoff/place-photos-research). Holds and people heroes / posts listed in the research STATUS.md (Needs placeholder, Current photo shows people) are applied too; this file wins.
